Zilean.teamfight: Start from the backline with Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, then finish with Neeko R Pop Blossom after the enemy is caught by your allies' engage. Zilean E Time Warp can target only one person at a time, so engage from multiple directions with your allies. Don't use abilities on a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while they are reviving; if that target is difficult to finish, go for the fragile Zilean himself.
Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches to you, move away from your allies and get outside the blast radius. If Zilean E Time Warp slows you, it becomes hard to avoid the bomb combo.

Zoe.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance against Zoe's damage, but focus first on dodging Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, since resistance can't reduce its true damage.
Zoe.combo: Your basic combo is to root with Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, place Neeko Q Blooming Burst, then land an empowered basic attack. When Zoe R Portal Jump or Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down and you have an engage opportunity, disguise yourself with Neeko P Inherent Glamour as you approach, then use Neeko E Tangle-Barbs to root her while preparing Neeko R Pop Blossom so the landing hits.
Zoe.escape: The moment after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is an opportunity to go in with Neeko R Pop Blossom. You can also close the distance while Zoe R Portal Jump is down; if she used it, target the spot she must return to with Neeko E Tangle-Barbs.
Zoe.fight: Send Neeko E Tangle-Barbs through minions to root Zoe, then deal damage. If you don't have an angle to root her, poke with Neeko W Shapesplitter's third empowered basic attack and wait. Look for an engage opportunity when Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down.
Zoe.laning: Throw Neeko E Tangle-Barbs through the minion wave to target Zoe. If Neeko Q Blooming Burst hits both the wave and Zoe, you can clear the wave and poke at the same time. Avoid forcing a trade after missing Neeko E Tangle-Barbs.
Zoe.phase: Later, choose the order for using Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom more carefully.
Zoe.teamfight: Start from the backline with Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, then go in with Neeko R Pop Blossom after Zoe is caught by your allies' engage or Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. If Zoe used Zoe R Portal Jump, target the spot where she will return. Watch out for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble traps left in narrow paths without vision and in front of objectives, and light up the area with a Control Ward before starting an objective.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you'll fall asleep shortly after, making you easy to hit with Zoe Q Paddle Star! the moment you fall asleep. Before you doze off, move behind a wall or an ally to get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!'s angle and range. If you see Zoe preparing to throw Zoe Q Paddle Star!, Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can interrupt her re-aiming.

Zyra.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Neeko has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Zyra.combo: Your basic trade is Neeko E Tangle-Barbs → Neeko Q Blooming Burst → basic attacks. When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down and you go in with your ultimate, disguise yourself with Neeko P Inherent Glamour as you approach, prepare Neeko R Pop Blossom, and use Neeko E Tangle-Barbs to root her so the landing hits.
Zyra.escape: The moment after dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to engage. Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Neeko R Pop Blossom and hold her with Neeko E Tangle-Barbs.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots to the side, then close the distance while its root is down. Root Zyra with Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and deal damage with Neeko Q Blooming Burst and basic attacks. If you don't have an angle to root her, poke with Neeko W Shapesplitter's empowered basic attack and wait.
Zyra.laning: Throw Neeko E Tangle-Barbs through minions to make it grow and travel faster, and extend its root. Keep count ahead of time so you don't use Neeko W Shapesplitter's third empowered basic attack on a minion; hit Zyra with it. Step on Zyra's seeds as you pass to destroy them, but if she tries to grow them with an ability, back off and step on them again afterward.
Zyra.phase: Later, Neeko has fewer options after using Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom, so choose your engage order more carefully.
Zyra.teamfight: Don't fight where Zyra has stayed for a long time and built up seeds and plants; move the fight elsewhere. Start from the backline with Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, then finish with Neeko R Pop Blossom after Zyra is caught by your allies' engage. If Zyra has placed plants far from herself, look for a chance to approach her.
Zyra.watch: When you see the summon indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, leave its area and use Neeko R Pop Blossom to escape if needed. If there are lots of plants, back off briefly and fight after they disappear.
